lines.text: God's wrath is revealed from heaven against men who suppress the truth, and His invisible qualities are seen in His workmanship.
Though they knew God, they did not thank Him, and they exchanged His glory for images of man, birds, animals and reptiles.
God gave them over to impurity, because they exchanged the truth of God for a lie and served the law.
Because they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a final warning.
They know God's decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, yet they continue and approve of others who do them.
